description: One-shot: build a module + variant, install it, and launch it. Resolves the target automatically - an explicit targetId wins, then the active session default, then whichever single emulator/device is connected; if more than one is connected without a pin, this fails with the candidate list instead of guessing. Launches via the default launcher activity unless `activity` is given.

activity.description: Fully-qualified activity to launch, e.g. "com.example.app.MainActivity". Defaults to the app's launcher activity.

name: build_run_device
title: Build, Install, and Launch
